p.note: A transformation cannot ask you to confirm a tool call. A tool that would ask for confirmation in the chat, such as an MCP tool, a command-line tool, or a tool contributed by a plugin, runs only if it is configured to always be allowed in the Unsafe tool auto-approval preferences page. Otherwise, the AI receives a refusal that identifies the entry to add, such as plugin:term_check_current_document safe-calls, and logs the refusal.
